next.reason: 2023 adds FROM literal-1 (§2023:14.9.35.4 GR7: "MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1"), which the 1985 format refuses; the FROM identifier-1 case is unchanged. 1985 REWRITE GR4: REWRITE FROM = 'MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1 according to the rules specified for the MOVE statement', then REWRITE without FROM. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR7 states the same two steps ('MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1 ... according to the rules specified for the MOVE statement'); §2023:14.9.35.3 SR6 restates the MOVE-validity part. literal-1 and the FILE form are additions outside 1985 programs.
